summary: Learn practical HR process automation with low-code workflows, service design, and dashboards. Build usable HR solutions without an ERP. Enrol today.
lede: Digital HR process automation and employee services design helps HR teams replace fragmented email, spreadsheet, paper, and approval-based work with clearer, more controlled employee services. Using BPMN 2.0, ISO 30414, low-code automation, cloud collaboration, and AI-assisted document handling, the course addresses recruitment, onboarding, performance, learning, and employee-service processes. You will learn to prioritise automation opportunities, define workflow requirements, configure approval routes, manage HR data fields, test exceptions, and report service metrics through Power BI or an equivalent tool. Practical work includes recruitment or onboarding, employee-service requests, and performance or learning administration, with deliverables including a process inventory, service blueprint, control checklist, KPI dashboard specification, and phased roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR and shared-services professionals who own employee lifecycle processes, coordinate approvals, manage HR data, or sponsor practical digital improvements. It suits beginner to intermediate users of low-code tools and does not require software development experience.
prerequisites: You should have working experience in at least one HR process such as recruitment, onboarding, performance administration, learning administration, or employee services. No coding or programming experience is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets, shared drives, email approvals, or a collaboration suite will help. Advanced platform configuration is introduced at an operational application level, while production deployment, custom integrations, and enterprise architecture remain outside the course scope. Bring a laptop if your delivery arrangement permits it; access to Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Google Workspace, or AppSheet is useful but not required for the core exercises.
